/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
def lev(a,b):
 if a==b:return 0
 n,m=len(a),len(b)
 if n<m:a,b=b,a;n,m=len(a),len(b)
 prev=list(range(m+1))
 for i,ca in enumerate(a,1):
  cur=[i]+[0]*m
  for j,cb in enumerate(b,1):
   cur[j]=min(prev[j]+1,cur[j-1]+1,prev[j-1]+(ca"'!=cb))
  prev=cur
 return prev[m]
h=open('"'human_segment.txt').read().strip()
s=''
print(len(h),len(s),lev(h,s))
print(s)
PY"
